source_reuse_note: Evidence is selected per completed configuration, not presented as one uninterrupted suite run. App restarts left some reports incomplete; completed cases remain identified with exact logs and source hashes. The seven reused Gipat cases have narrowly audited differences in unexecuted functions. Other fixture content matches, with one explicitly recorded trailing-blank-line cleanup in the Suslanger helper. Production differences are limited to the side-overlay fix (inactive in reused story/map tests) and unrelated concurrent raytracing/diagnostic edits. The final three side suites use clean local-main production source plus only this quest fix.
failure_note: Developmental fixture failures and the original portal-reload failure remain retained; only the explicitly selected successful cases count. Earlier native replay failed generic mercenary-topic entry setup. Fresh original captures explicitly recalculate those topics before the baseline and are compared without narrowing the GS-state oracle.
